intro.titulo: An educational journey that widens references, builds skills and opens new paths.
intro.texto: Tocando em Frente starts from real challenges that limit the possibilities of many young people and responds with an educational Journey — curriculum, role-model stories and hands-on experiences — to widen perspectives, build skills and strengthen each student’s agency.

centro.texto: Hover over any point of the circle to understand how each piece connects.

categorias.tituloCompleto: Lack of role models and opportunities
categorias.resumo: The absence of role models, examples of success and concrete opportunities limits what many young people can imagine for their own future — and feeds a cycle that is hard to break alone.

itens.texto: Without seeing a practical purpose in their studies, students disengage — one of the main reasons for school dropout in Brazil.
Low aspirations and expectations are reflected directly in grades and in staying in school.
When school seems disconnected from the future, dropping out becomes a more likely path.
Without access to role models and resources, the same socioeconomic inequalities repeat across generations.

itens.titulo: Perpetuation of the cycle of poverty
itens.texto: Fewer educational opportunities today mean fewer chances to break out of poverty tomorrow.

categorias.resumo: Tocando em Frente’s answer: a Journey that widens repertoire with a gamified curriculum and real stories from people who have already broken through these barriers.

itens.texto: Gamified, active activities build socio-emotional skills and connect school content to real paths.
Young people with different talents and backgrounds show, in practice, that dreaming big is possible.

categorias.resumo: With more repertoire and references, students widen their perspectives and start to see — and pursue — more possibilities.

itens.texto: More clarity about their own future translates into more engagement and better school results.
Students come to know and pursue opportunities in different fields of knowledge.

categorias.resumo: In the medium and long term, this journey helps reduce school dropout and paves the way for the students themselves to become new role models.

itens.texto: Public-school youth in leadership positions — new role models for the next generation.

itens.titulo: Less dropout, more staying in school
itens.texto: More engaged students have more reasons to stay in school.

kumu.texto: Tocando em Frente’s full Theory of Change — with all the evidence and references behind this model — is available for anyone who wants to dig deeper.
